description: This is a C# source file containing performance test class 'CountersGrainTests' for event-sourced counters. It includes test methods for measuring the performance of different configurations such as reentrancy and storage strategies, specifically within the Orleans framework. It also defines a custom test case orderer and some auxiliary attributes.

classes.name: CountersGrainTests
